kernelCapture.menu: Kernel Plugin Example: External Capture Service
kernelCapture.title: External Capture Service
kernelCapture.intro: A concrete Kernel Plugin example: trusted external tools send a capture request, the kernel-owned service applies your routing rules, and SiYuan writes the result to today's Daily Note.
kernelCapture.serviceLifetime: The service does not belong to this panel
kernelCapture.serviceLifetimeHelp: The Kernel service starts with the SiYuan kernel. This Svelte panel connects later and can close without stopping the service.
kernelCapture.targetNotebookHelp: The Kernel service owns this routing configuration. Preview has no side effects; writing requires an explicit action.
kernelCapture.separationTitle: Prove that the service runs without the UI
kernelCapture.separationHelp: Run the generated command while this panel is closed. The Kernel service receives and writes the capture, then its broadcast asks each visible frontend to open this panel again.
kernelCapture.separationStep1: Save a target notebook, then copy the runnable command.
kernelCapture.separationStep2: Close this panel and run the command in your terminal.
kernelCapture.separationStep3: The Kernel handles the request without this panel. The openUi field then asks each visible frontend to open the panel with the result.
kernelCapture.tokenWarning: The SiYuan API token is an administrator credential, not a capture-only token. Keep it in a trusted local credential store and do not expose this endpoint directly to the Internet.
